title: Martin Chuzzlewit
author: Charles Dickens
description: Family rivalries and selfish ambitions unfold in Dickens’s satire of inheritance.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
editionCredits: Produced by Donald Lainson; David Widger
longDescription: This complete historical edition offers room to follow the author’s voice, setting and central concerns at their original pace. Character, social circumstance and the choices people make are part of its enduring appeal. The source edition retains its period language and introductory material; explore the credited source for publication and edition details.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.
authorInfo.edition: All five staves of the novella. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.

rightsReview.policy: Source states US public domain; listed creative contributors died by 1945. Unknown dates excluded. This is a screening record, not a legal certification.
